hypothesis: Isotonic calibration will reduce ECE more than sigmoid calibration
evidence: ECE dropped from 0.070 (sigmoid) to 0.066 (isotonic) on GB, and 0.069 to 0.074 on LightGBM. Isotonic is better on GB, worse on LightGBM.

hypothesis: LightGBM will outperform GradientBoosting on accuracy and log-loss
evidence: LightGBM accuracy 0.533 vs GB 0.550. GB wins on synthetic data.

hypothesis: Stacking ensemble will outperform individual models on all predictive metrics
evidence: Stacking accuracy 0.579, log-loss 0.965, ECE 0.052 — best across all metrics.

hypothesis: Richer features (10 vs 4) will improve ML layer accuracy by >2%
evidence: Rich features add goal_diff, conceded averages, form points — all shift-based, no leakage.

hypothesis: Model configurations can overcome bookmaker margin in synthetic world
evidence: All single-model configs show negative ROI (-28.8%). Synthetic bookmaker margin is the dominant factor.

hypothesis: Conformal prediction will provide valid uncertainty intervals with finite-sample coverage
1M Monte Carlo simulation will show that positive ROI is within noise for most configurations
